purpose: Fit one leakage-safe prior-year zero-intercept anomaly coefficient per horizon and apply a constrained anomaly correction.

parameters.minimum_training_years: default 3 distinct prior issue years for beta fitting

outputs: anomaly_relaxation_forecast.json using the common three-horizon forecast schema
failure_conditions: state date is incomplete in legal observations
provenance_generated: training case years and row counts
scientific_assumptions: one non-seasonal beta is fitted per horizon
beta uses zero-intercept OLS on completed weekly cases from years strictly before issue year
training target windows must be complete before issue-year start
current issue targets are not model inputs
manifest_status: internal portability aid; not an official LifeWatch manifest
